modalities.evidence: Clinical data encompasses Baseline Clinical Data, In-hospital follow-up and data after hospital discharge

output.population: 768 patients diagnosed with CAP at Clinica Universidad de La Sabana, Colombia
output.summary: Prospective observational cohort of hospitalized community-acquired pneumonia patients, with baseline clinical data, in-hospital follow-up and post-discharge data, supporting study of phenotypes, endotypes and biomarkers of adverse outcomes.
